title: Mean bound for the minority indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube $\\{-1,1\}^n$ to $\{-1,1\}$, and let $\delta\in\mathbb R$. If $1-\delta\le |\mathbb E f|$, where the mean is taken uniformly over the sign cube, then the uniform mean of the minority indicator of $f$ is at most $\delta/2$.
